programs.title: Sullivan's Crossing
programs.desc: Sully tries to hold things together at Sullivan's Crossing, while Maggie attempts to navigate complications back in Boston, Mass.

programs.title: The Living Daylights
programs.desc: British secret agent James Bond (Timothy Dalton) helps KGB officer Georgi Koskov (Jeroen Krabbé) defect during a symphony performance. During his debriefing, Koskov reveals that a policy of assassinating defectors has been instated by new KGB head Leonid Pushkin (John Rhys-Davies). But as Bond explores this threat, a counterplot surfaces, involving a shady American arms dealer (Joe Don Baker) and a pair of Russian assassins, Necros (Andreas Wisniewski) and Kara Milovy (Maryam d'Abo).

programs.title: Christmas at the Greenbrier
programs.desc: Widowed mother Abby and former professional football player Ben unexpectedly reunite while visiting the Greenbrier, forcing the duo to figure out if true love is still a priority.

programs.title: Flamin' Hot
programs.desc: Richard Montanez, the son of a Mexican immigrant, was a janitor at Frito-Lay when he came up with the idea for Flamin' Hot Cheetos. His creation, inspired by the flavors of his community, revitalized Frito-Lay and disrupted the food industry.

programs.title: Transplant
programs.desc: Bash provides medical care to a friend who is reluctant about treatment, while Mags has her hands full with a young woman who seems to be withholding information; Dr. Bishop offers Mags an incredible opportunity.

programs.title: Corner Gas
programs.desc: Oscar kicks off the New Year with startling news about his national identity; the gang gets involved in a resolution contest.
